verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration-services provider with case dashboards and People Ops integration, so an official MCP server is a plausible offering and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no MCP server, and probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec. The 'apply via an agent' mention refers to a visa petitioning agent, not an AI agent, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
